evidence.source_statement: When generating or recommending new names for projects, products, applications, repositories, tools, or other user-named entities, do not propose candidate names whose final letters are 'arium', regardless of letter case.
source_conditions: Proposing a new name; established names may still be mentioned.
source_exceptions: Does not prevent discussing historical or existing names.
